question: What concrete human and creative encounter can The Sea and Seven Villages add to the cinema series?
research_query: Sea Seven Villages; query_research returned no indexed records, tasks or shared publications. Focused article search found no substantive existing section. Limited search, not an exhaustive absence claim.

findings: The producer’s page names Iti Samanta, director Himansu S. Khatua and displaced Satabhaya communities in Kendrapara.

In a 31 October 2023 interview, Khatua recalls meeting resettled families at Bagapatia and visiting their former villages. He describes filming a temple’s deterioration. This is a named filmmaker’s account, not independently viewed footage or direct resident testimony.
The official 71st National Film Awards results identify a non-feature Special Mention for 2023, announced 1 August 2025. The award recipient listed as producer is Kadambini Media Pvt. Ltd.
PIB reported an IFFI screening on 22 November 2023. That event is distinct from the later national recognition.
coverage_decision: Add a small documentary section to the existing overview, placed after Bhukha before children’s cinema, with an onward link to Lipika Singh Darai. Preserve all existing prose and images; no standalone film/profile page until broader evidence supports one.
limitations: No whole-film viewing, audition or direct resident response claimed.
No adaptation from a literary work established for this documentary. Its connection to the series is people, place and memory.
Do not adopt news claims of the first place affected by climate change or treat the producer synopsis as environmental research.
Do not adopt some news reports’ incorrect Best Odia non-feature award label.
Official-looking video search lead remains unverified; no public viewing link added.
Producer images explicitly reserved; no new image reused or generated.
next_research: Investigate Mo Bou, Mo Gaan through an original filmmaker or institutional festival account, seeking a concrete family/community or making encounter. Reuse the saved 71st-awards record and preserve its shared Best Biographical / Historical Reconstruction / Compilation Film category. For a fuller Sea And Seven Villages page later, seek an authorized viewing route and a resident’s own public account; no need repeat the verified producer, interview or award searches.
outcome: Added Documentary and the memory of home to the cinema overview: The Sea and Seven Villages, producer Iti Samanta and Himansu Sekhar Khatua’s attributed account of Bagapatia families and filming their former villages. Non-feature Special Mention kept precise; linked Lipika Singh Darai. Two new numbered notes and an extended shared award locator. Both 50-reading books rebuilt with 256 digital/262 print pages and 476 notes. Independent source/content/mapping and eleven-page PDF review, browser footnotes/link and focused checks passed. Prior prose, images, covers, older editions and published downloads preserved. No publication.
